changelog: Insert narrow surface check after C5 to block cuts that detach auxiliaries/negation/verbs from the token classes that typically supply their object/complement or resolve scope (addresses the primary finding while remaining a surface check).
Replace example E1 with the measured labeled example en_us_738 (high-gap case illustrating predicate/auxiliary detachment) to teach the ranking directly where the deficit occurs.
Replace example E1 with the measured labeled example en_us_101 showing numeral+unit separation failures; a measured case teaches the ranking directly for the primary finding about numerals and units.

Insert a narrow surface check after C5 that blocks cuts which would leave an auxiliary/modal/negation or bare verb separated from an immediately following argument or measurement phrase — addresses the primary finding while avoiding a blanket verb–complement prohibition.

Insert a narrow surface check after C5 that forbids cutting a numeral/quantifier apart from its immediately following measurement or unit phrase, to protect number+unit cohesion and address the primary finding.
Replace example E1 with measured labeled example en_us_990 to teach the model about cuts that detach scope-bearing predicates/auxiliaries (addresses the primary finding with a real high-gap case).
Replace example E2 with measured labeled example en_us_1612 to teach numeral+unit cohesion (addresses the secondary finding about separating numbers from units).
Replace Example E1 with measured labeled example en_us_1050 to teach numeral+unit cohesion (protect numbers and units from being split).
Replace Example E2 with measured labeled example en_us_1157 to reinforce keeping measurement tokens (e.g. +30°C) together with their numeric context.

Insert a narrow surface check after C5: block cuts that leave an auxiliary/modal/negation or main verb separated from a following pronoun, determiner, or numeral — addresses the primary finding by preventing verb/scope detachment only when surface cues show the continuation likely supplies the verb's object/complement or resolves scope.

Insert a narrow surface check after C5 to forbid cuts that separate a numeral/quantifier from its immediately following measurement or unit phrase, addressing the primary finding about number+unit cohesion.
